name: Teen Service Learner
what_you_do: Help branch staff organize library materials and take part in library events while earning community service hours and work experience.
who_can_apply: Teens, generally ages 12 to 17. The exact age range varies by branch, so ask your branch.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Ask your branch.
how_to_apply: Ask a staff member at your San Diego County Library branch how to sign up.
notes: Run by the County library system, which is separate from the City of San Diego Public Library. The page lists no teen requirements; the background check and medical exam it mentions are for adult volunteers. Confirm your branch's age range before going.
